executable.title: Export Segment Statistics
executable.description: Export saved ruler lengths longest first, segment volumes, and underlay image statistics as CSV.

parameters.label: Input and output
parameters.description: Existing segment measurements and their downloadable report.

image.name: inputVolume
image.label: Input Volume
image.description: Source volume for per-segment minimum, maximum, mean, median, population standard deviation, and sum.

image.name: inputLabelmap
image.label: Input Label Map
image.description: Painted scalar integer label maps. Embedded segment names match ruler labels.

file.name: outputReport
file.label: Measurement Report
file.description: CSV of segment volumes, source-image statistics, warnings, and numbered ruler lengths up to the largest ruler group.

parameters.label: Existing annotations
parameters.description: Saved rulers associated with the input volume.

file.name: inputAnnotations
file.label: Input Annotations
file.description: Optional saved rulers labeled with their segment name.

parameters.label: Girder API
parameters.description: Server access injected by slicer_cli_web; not shown to users.
